notes.title: UPDATE 16th of March, 2017 - Peripherals
notes.content:
UPDATE 16th of March, 2017
We have released a second patch, in order to address peripherals that weren't working yet.

ORIGINAL POST
We have recently published an update to solve some recent issues with several supported driving wheels. 
If you still have issues after the patch, please report in the comments.
Here is the list of brands and models involved:

Thrustmaster T150 Racing Wheel
Thrustmaster T300RS Racing Wheel
Thrustmaster TX Racing Wheel
Thrustmaster F340 Force Feedback
Thrustmaster T500RS Racing Wheel
Thrustmaster RGT Force Feedback Pro

Logitech G25 Racing Wheel
Logitech G27 Racing Wheel
Logitech Driving Force GT
Logitech Driving Force PRO
Logitech G29 Driving Force Racing Wheel
Logitech G920 Driving Force Racing Wheel

Fanatec 911 GT2 EU
Fanatec 911 GT3 RS
Fanatec 911 Turbo S
Fanatec ClubSport Wheel V2

notes.title: #SLRallyEVO NOW AVAILABLE
notes.content:
[img]https://scontent-mxp1-1.xx.fbcdn.net/hphotos-xtf1/t31.0-8/c0.0.851.315/p851x315/12622514_694745770667765_2500467007574138611_o.png[/img]

Hey Top Drivers!

[b]The Sébastien Loeb Rally Experience is now available for STEAM™.
From Day1 available the first Patch.[/b]

[i]“We’re glad that starting from today the players all over the world can enjoy the unique and realistic experience of Sébastien Loeb Rally EVO”[/i], affirms, [b]Luisa Bixio [/b]V.P. Milestone. [i]“This new Milestone IP marks a new qualitative standard for all the future Rally videogames developed by Milestone Team. We are confident that players will appreciate the passion we’ve put into this game and the high quality level we’ve reach” [/i]concludes [b]Bixio.[/b]

[i]“I’m really happy that all the players can play, from now on, Sébastien Loeb Rally EVO. The partnership with Milestone Team during the development allowed us to create a terrific product. This game includes realism and all the elements of my career at the same time. Now the players have to start the engine of the car, play online and try to beat my best lap and records”[/i], says [b]S.Loeb.[/b]

[b]The main features of Sébastien Loeb Rally EVO are: [/b]
[list]
[*]The 9 time world championship expertise – S.Loeb
[*]More than 300Km of tracks faithful reproduced and based by real ones
[*]The exclusive Pikes Peak International Hill Climb, one of the most famous race in the world with more than 20km
[*]8 different Rallyes: Monaco, Sweden, Mexico, Australia, Italy, Finland, France and Wales
[*]64 Special Stages
[*]5 Rallycross circuits: Lohèac, Los Angeles, Franciacorta, Trois-Rivières and San Luis
[*]16 car manufacturers: Citroën, Peugeot, Ford, VolksWagen, Audi, Subaru, Suzuki, Abarth, etc.
[*]58 Cars from 60s till nowadays
[*]Several Game Modes created for the Rally Drivers: Quick Race, Career, Sébastien Loeb Experience, Online Multiplayer and much more…
[*]Customization for creating the perfect match between aesthetic and race style
[*]Several Weather an Light Conditions to test player drive skills
[*]A realistic physics and sound that reacts differently depending on each single in-game object developed with S.Loeb
[*]Amazing compatibility with the main drive peripherals available on shelves – Steering Wheels, gearshift and pedals
[/list]
[b]From Day 1 will be available the first Patch for Sébastien Loeb Rally EVO. [/b]

[b]The changelog includes:[/b]
[list]
[*]Improved weight transfer for all the vehicles
[*]Improved suspensions movement for all the vehicles
[*]Improved the behavior of the dampers for all the vehicles
[*]Improved the gear ratios for all the vehicles
[*]Improved the mapping of the engine for the Fiat Abarth Grande Punto S2000
[*]Improved the mapping of the engine for the Peugeot 205 T16 Pikes Peak
[*]Improved the mapping of the engine for the Peugeot 208 Pikes Peak
[*]Improved the grip for all the Pikes Peak cars
[*]Improved of the aerodynamics simulation for all the vehicles
[*]Improved the differential for all the vehicles
[*]Improved the setups of all the vehicles for all the different terrains topology
[*]Improved the Pikes Peak cars performance
[*]Improved the handling for all the vehicles
[*]Improved AI performance
[/list]
[b]Sébastien Loeb Rally EVO[/b] represents the excellence among Rally Games. It will stick the players to the steering wheels through an amazing world tour featuring all the elements of Sébastien Loeb career. Sébastien Loeb Rally EVO is pure adrenaline experience.

Visit our [url=https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=4EJLjhKXnqc]Official YouTube Channel[/url] to watch the [b]new video[/b]!

[url=http://milestone.it/?lang=en]Milestone Team[/url]

notes.content:
[img]http://sebastienloebrallyevo.com/wp-content/uploads/thumb-demo-montecarlo.jpg[/img]

Milestone is glad to announce that, starting from today, 21th January 2015, will be downloadable a DEMO on STEAM™. The release date of the Game is officially scheduled on 29th January 2016 for PS4™, Xbox One® and Windows PC/STEAM™.

Demo will include the following contents: 

[b]Track: 	[/b]
[list]
    [*]Montecarlo – Sisteron
[/list]
[b]Cars:	[/b]
[list]
    [*]Mini Cooper S (70s)
    [*]Peugeot R5
    [*]Polo Rally Car
[/list]
[b]Game mode:	[/b]
[list]
    [*]Rally single stage
    [*]Playground Time Attack and Challenge Time Attack – a technical location where the player can test the reactions of the car on different surfaces like asphalt and dirt road
[/list]

Visit our [url=https://www.youtube.com/channel/UCHnx3WFBlaos4JDm6KmtDxg]Official YouTube Channel[/url] to watch the [b]new video[/b]!

[url=http://milestone.it/?lang=en]Milestone Team[/url]
